Mohlala, tlhaloso ya sediriši ya `list:Blocked` e tla lekanyetša patlo go dikarata tše di lego lenaneong le le bitšwago *Blocked*. Ge boleng bo na le dikgoba goba ditlhaka tše di kgethegilego bo swanetše go tsenywa ka gare ga maswao a ditsopolwa (mohl. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).

globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Didiriši tše dintši di ka laetšwa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Didiriši tše di swanago di kopanywa ka *OR*. Dikarata tše di swanago le seemo sefe goba sefe di tla bušwa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` e tla buša dikarata tše di lego lenaneong lefe goba lefe le le bitšwago *Blocked* goba *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Didiriši tše di fapanego di kopanywa ka *AND*. Go bušwa feela dikarata tše di swanago le didiriši ka moka tše di fapanego. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` e buša feela dikarata lenaneong la *Available* tše di nago le leibole ye *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Matšatši a ka laetšwa ka palotlalo ya go feta goba ya ka fase ga lefeela goba ka `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` goba `__predicate_year__` bakeng sa nako ya bjale.

database-migration-description: Huduša data ye e theilwego go sengwalwa (tšohle ka ntle le dikgomaretšwa le diswantšho tša boitsebišo, tše di šalago tshepedišong ya difaele) magareng ga MongoDB le FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Polokelo ye nngwe ya tshedimošo e swanetše go ba e šoma le go fihlelelega (dikgorwana tša tlwaelo: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; fetola ka WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Ge e feditše, šupetša MONGO_URL polokelong ye nngwe ya tshedimošo gomme o thome WeKan gape (go Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb goba =mongodb).

database-migration-done: Khudugo ya data ya sengwalwa e phethilwe.
sandstorm-migration-description: Ge WeKan e šoma ka gare ga grain ya Sandstorm, polokelo ya yona ya kgale ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB 3 e hudušetšwa go FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ge e thongwa la mathomo, gomme dikgomaretšwa le diswantšho tša boitsebišo di šuthišwa go tšwa polokelong ya tshedimošo go difolthara tša grain tša files/attachments le files/avatars. Se se bontšha ge khudugo yeo e atlegile le gore difaele tša kgale tše tala tša polokelo ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB di sa diriša sekgoba se se kaakang sa tisiki ka gare ga grain, gomme se go dumelela go phumola difaele tšeo tše tala go lokolla sekgoba.

sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Phumola difaele tše tala tša polokelo ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Ka morago ga khudugo ye e atlegilego data e dula go FerretDB le tshepedišong ya difaele, ka gona difaele tša kgale tše tala tša polokelo ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB 3 di ka phumolwa go lokolla sekgoba sa tisiki sa grain. Se se ka se dirollwe.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Phumola difaele tše tala tša polokelo ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB 3 go lokolla sekgoba sa tisiki? Data e šetše e hudušeditšwe go FerretDB le tshepedišong ya difaele. Se se ka se dirollwe.

cards-loading-lazy: Go diegišwa (dikarata tše di bonagalago feela)
cards-loading-description: WeKan e laiša dikarata tša boto ka go itiriša: boto ye kgolo (ye e fetago mollwane wa bogolo) e laiša feela dikarata tše di bonagalago ga bjale (go sepetša go go sa felego) le palo ya bjale, gore e dule e potlakile gomme e diriše kgopolo le bophara bja kgokagano bjo bonyenyane, mola diboto tše nnyane di laiša karata ye nngwe le ye nngwe bakeng sa boitemogelo bjo bonolo le bjo bo nago le dikarolo ka botlalo. Ga go na seo se swanetšego go beakanywa. Balaodi ba sa dutše ba ka gapeletša mokgwa ka diphetogo tša tikologo tša CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) le CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Go laiša dikarata ka go diega ke ga teko: dipalo tša dikarata le mellwane ya WIP di nepagetše, eupša diponagalo tša Khalentara/Tafola/Gantt le kgetho ya tše dintši di bontšha feela dikarata tše di laišitšwego go fihla bjale. Laiša diboto tše di butšwego gape ka morago ga go fetola se.
render-links-as-plain-text: Bontšha dikgokaganyo bjalo ka sengwalwa feela
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, dikgokaganyo ka moka (bobedi dikgokaganyo tša markdown tša go swana le [label](url) le ditheke tše tala tša HTML <a href>) ka mehla di bontšhwa bjalo ka sengwalwa se se sa kgotlegego lebaleng le lengwe le le lengwe la sengwalwa se se humilego (dihlogo tša boto le karata, ditlhalošo, ditshwaotshwao, mananeo a go hlahloba, bj.bj.). Se se thibela dikgokaganyo tše di kgotlegago tše di forago. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe, ka gona dikgokaganyo di dula di kgotlega.
always-show-code-as-text: Ka mehla bontšha khoutu ka moka bjalo ka sengwalwa feela
always-show-code-as-text-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, sengwalwa se se humilego ga se ke se bontšhwa bjalo ka markdown goba HTML: mothopo ka moka ka mehla o bontšhwa bjalo ka sengwalwa feela lebaleng le lengwe le le lengwe la sengwalwa se se humilego (dihlogo tša boto le karata, ditlhalošo, ditshwaotshwao, mananeo a go hlahloba, bj.bj.). Se se utolla diteng tše di utilwego — ditshwaotshwao tša HTML (<!-- -->), mo dikgokaganyo tša markdown di yago gona, JavaScript le khoutu efe goba efe — gore khoutu ka moka e dule e bonagala, e sa kgotlege e bile e sa šome. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe, ka gona markdown e bontšhwa ka mokgwa wa tlwaelo.
disable-all-import-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, dikarolo ka moka tša go tsenya di a timiwa: go tsenya boto go tšwa go WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea le Forgejo, gammogo le go kopiša boto. Dikgetho tša menyu wa go tsenya di a fihliwa gomme sebara e gana kgopelo efe goba efe ya go tsenya. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-all-export-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, dikarolo ka moka tša go ntšha di a timiwa: go ntšha boto bjalo ka WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, goba go NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, le go ntšha sekgomaretšwa se tee. Dikgetho tša menyu wa go ntšha di a fihliwa gomme sebara e gana kgopelo efe goba efe ya go ntšha. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-import-avatars: Tima go tsenya diswantšho tša boitsebišo
disable-import-avatars-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, diswantšho tša boitsebišo (diswantšho tša profaele ya mošomiši) ga di ke di tsenywa. Se se akaretša go tsenya WeKan JSON, go tsenya Trello le go nyalantšha diswantšho tša boitsebišo go tšwa go baneedi ba boitsebišo ba ka ntle ge go tsenwa (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Maina le data ye nngwe di sa tsenywa; go tshelwa feela diswantšho tša boitsebišo. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-export-avatars: Tima go ntšha diswantšho tša boitsebišo
disable-export-avatars-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, diswantšho tša boitsebišo (diswantšho tša profaele ya mošomiši) ga di ke di akaretšwa ge boto e ntšhwa (ntšho ya WeKan JSON le CSV). Maina a badiriši le data ye nngwe di sa ntšhwa; go tlogelwa feela diswantšho tša boitsebišo. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
anonymize-import-users: Tloša boitsebišo bja badiriši ba ba tsenywago
anonymize-import-users-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, go tsenya boto ya WeKan JSON go tšeela leina la mošomiši, leina ka botlalo le ditlhaka tša mathomo tša mošomiši yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo a tsentšwego legato ka diswari tša lefelo tša sebadi (user1, user2, ...), go tloša seswantšho sa gagwe sa boitsebišo, le go ngwala gape dipolelo tša @username (le mabala a requested-by / assigned-by) ka gare ga diteng tša karata le tshwaotshwao tše di tsentšwego. Ga go boitsebišo bja nnete bja mošomiši go tšwa botong ya mothopo bjo bo bolokwago. Lentšu la "mošomiši" le latela leleme la motho yo a tsenyago. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
anonymize-export-users: Tloša boitsebišo bja badiriši ba ba ntšhwago
anonymize-export-users-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, go ntšha boto go tšeela leina la mošomiši, leina ka botlalo le ditlhaka tša mathomo tša mošomiši yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo a ntšhwago legato ka diswari tša lefelo tša sebadi (user1, user2, ...), go tloša seswantšho sa gagwe sa boitsebišo, le go ngwala gape dipolelo tša @username (le mabala a requested-by / assigned-by) ka gare ga diteng tša karata le tshwaotshwao. Faele ye e ntšhitšwego ga e na boitsebišo bja nnete bja mošomiši. Lentšu la "mošomiši" le latela leleme la motho yo a ntšhago. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-activities-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, dikgatišo tša phepelo ya mešongwana ga di ngwalwe e bile ga di bontšhwe kae goba kae (para ya ka thoko ya boto le thepe ya mošongwana wa karata). Ga go histori ya gore ke mang yo a dirilego eng ye e bolokwago. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-notifications-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, WeKan ga e romele ditsebišo tša go bogela (ka gare ga tirišo, imeile goba ditirelo tše dingwe) tša mošongwana ofe goba ofe. Mešongwana e sa ka ngwalwa (ntle le ge le yona e timilwe ka godimo); go thibelwa feela ditsebišo. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-watch-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, karolo ya go bogela e a timiwa — badiriši ba ka se ingwadišetše diboto, mananeo goba dikarata go amogela ditsebišo, gomme maiteko afe goba afe a go fetola maemo a go bogela a a ganwa. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
backup-description: Boloka khophi ya Dikgomaretšwa, Diswantšho tša boitsebišo le/goba Data (dikgoboketšo ka moka tše di theilwego go sengwalwa tše e sego dikgomaretšwa goba diswantšho tša boitsebišo). .zip e elela thwii go polokelo ye e kgethilwego — ga go faele ya nakwana — bjalo ka backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, e swerego YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars le /data. Dipolokelo tša leru (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) di diriša mangwalo a netefatšo ao a beakantšwego dithepong tša tšona tša polokelo.
backup-scope-description: Sistimi ka moka, goba Mokgatlo o tee. Khophi ya polokelo ya Mokgatlo e swere diboto tša wona le tšohle tše di lego go tšona, go akaretšwa dikgomaretšwa tša diboto tšeo — eupša ga e na diakhaonto tša badiriši le dipeakanyo tša sistimi, ka gobane tšeo di abelanwa ke Mokgatlo wo mongwe le wo mongwe. Go bušetša khophi ya polokelo ya Mokgatlo go ngwala feela dibotong tše Mokgatlo woo o nago le tšona.

gcs-credentials-description: Ya boikgethelo: kgomaretša senotlelo sa JSON sa akhaonto ya tirelo. Tlogela go se na selo go diriša faele ya senotlelo goba mangwalo a netefatšo a tlwaelo.
gcs-permissions-note: Fa akhaonto ya tirelo ya WeKan phihlelelo ya go bala/go ngwala paketeng: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → pakete ya gago → Permissions → Grant access. Go "New principals", kgomaretša imeile ya akhaonto ya tirelo — boleng bja "client_email" go tšwa senotlelong sa gago sa JSON — ke moka o kgethe karolo ya "Storage Object Admin" gomme o Boloke.

s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: tlogela go se na selo (e diriša ntlha ya mafelelo ya selete). Ye e sepelelanago le S3: URL ya Endpoint go tšwa khonsoleng ya gago ya MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → pakete ya gago → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → leina la pakete ya gago (goba Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → mošomiši wa gago → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → kgetha taba ya tšhomišo ya 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. E bontšhwa bjalo ka 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Sekirini se se swanago le Access key ID; 'Secret access key' e bontšhwa gatee feela ge senotlelo se hlangwa — se kopiše ka nako yeo (goba Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaonto ya gago → leina le le bontšhwago godimo (gape ka fase ga Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaonto ya gago → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaonto ya gago → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaonto ya gago → Data storage → Containers → seswaro sa gago (goba + Container go hlama se seswa).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → sekgethi sa protšeke godimo → ID ya protšeke ya gago (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → leina la pakete ya gago (goba Create go hlama ye mpsha).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Tsela sebareng ya WeKan ya go ya faeleng ya senotlelo sa JSON sa akhaonto ya tirelo ye e taoneloutitšwego (ye e hlamilwego ka tlase). Diriša se GOBA o kgomaretše JSON lebaleng le le lego ka tlase.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → akhaonto ya gago ya tirelo → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (e taonelouta faele). Kgomaretša diteng tša yona mo, goba boloka faele gomme o beakanye tsela ya yona ka godimo.
